title: Information, United States v. Fahima Egeh Mahamud, No. 0:26-cr-00097-JWB, Doc. 26
issuing_body: United States District Court, District of Minnesota; public copy hosted by U.S. Department of Justice, Criminal Division
court: United States District Court, District of Minnesota
notes: Court-filed Information, Doc. 26, filed 2026-05-20. Count 1 charges wire fraud under 18 U.S.C. §§ 1343 and 2 in connection with the Federal Child Nutrition Program / Feeding Our Future conduct; Count 2 charges conspiracy to defraud the United States under 18 U.S.C. § 371 in connection with the separate Child Care Assistance Program conduct. The charging allegations are not adjudicated facts. DOJ's July 2026 Minnesota case-summary page separately summarizes the same filing.
